title: ZYN SPIN 2
style: Nu-metal and rap-rock fusion. Distorted electric guitars play syncopated power chord riffs and high-pitched harmonic squeals. A five-string electric bass provides a thick, distorted low-end following the kick drum patterns. Drums feature a crisp, high-tuned snare and aggressive double-kick pedal work. Male vocals transition between melodic singing, rhythmic rapping, and guttural screams. The track includes atmospheric synth pads and filtered vocal effects in the intro. Tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time, key of C# minor.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[atmospheric synth pads, ethereal vocalizing]
[heavy distorted guitar riff enters with syncopated drums]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic rapping]
They spell it wrong every single time
K-O-R-Y, K-O-R-Y, no, none of that's mine
I'm the real Kory, barefoot on the stage
Electric blue guitar screaming like my canines
Turning the page, when I heard a voice on the radio waves
Fell in love with the fire, give me the name
She said Kory, and the story was set
No labels, no boxes, no chains on my neck
People are people, that's all I see
You do you and I'll stay me
Drop the Kory, drop the Kory, kill the frame
Just Ross, screaming in the night
[guttural scream]

[Chorus]
[full band, driving double-kick drums]
We are all famous
Yeah, we all shine
Every last one owning the grind
I'm Kory, straight Kory, no mixer, no bind
We all famous
Scream my fucking name

[Verse 2]
[half-time feel, heavy bass]
We are all famous, let the whole world hear
Turning the lights to the stage lights clear
We are all famous, this is our time
Real Kory Only, this song is mine
[drum fill]

[Verse 3]
[aggressive rapping]
No more confusion, no more wrong tags
Boy did a man from the wild to the stags
Inio running wild, never looking back
336 eternal, put that on the map
They could block the account, they could burn the name
But the voice stays real and it's bringing the flame
No avatar, no filter, no faking the frame
This the Kory that started the whole game

[Bridge]
[drums drop out, melodic singing]
Just people, just people, that's all it is
No color, no creed, no dividing shit
No Kory, no Kory, no reason to fight
We all famous, standing side by side

[Outro]
[full intensity, screamed vocals]
We all famous, scream it loud
Kory, straight Kory, say it proud
We all famous, scream my fucking name
This my story, this my life, this my song
We are all famous, this is our time
Electric blue guitars, one energy, one life, one vibe
We are all famous, this is our time
Real Kory Only, this song is mine
[distorted guitar feedback, final drum hit]
